title: Moving address by address and starting to play
summary: He moves to El Monster Avenue at about 16, plays without pay in the district, and then on Burry and Spain Street begins playing in earnest.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: And then after you moved, uh, from Port, where did you move?

When I moved from Poot Street, let's see. I moved, I come up to El Monster Avenue. Yeah, El Monster Avenue. I moved the same number. No, yeah. 14, 16, Poot Street, 14, 16, El Monster Avenue. I'll never forget that.
And how old were you when you were living on El Monster Avenue?
Oh, I don't know, I think I was about 16.
Were you playing music then?
I was playing on music, I was blowing.
You were blowing, huh?
Yeah, playing on the band.
Were you working with bands at all? Were you blowing with bands?
No, I wasn't blowing with no bands. Sometimes they'd take me out, I wouldn't call out of there.
But you weren't getting paid, right? No.

I didn't get paid when I went to the district playing. I was picked up and I was playing, and they needed to sit in the district. All we done took a fair long pass and made them, made them a pittance by cutting them down, put them on, went on up there and played, but we didn't get paid. But it was alright enough for us to stay on the job until they get back. And after the time for them to knock off, when they got back.
Who was some of the other men in the bands when you went to play in the district? Some of them bands?

Well, when I went up there, Joe Oliver, Joe Oliver, let's see. You gotta remember now. I know T.O. was out there. T.O., Louie. T.O., Louie and Rocky. Them, them were the places we would go. Do they have little short bands or big orchestras? Well, they run into five piece bands. Back to Almas Avenue, how old were you when you moved away from there? Mm-hm, I didn't sit around there. I don't remember that. It was good.
Where did you move to after that?
I was coming to Burry, between Spain and Simran.
And you stood there a while?
I stood there quite a while. And after time I started playing.

That's when you started really playing. Really playing. And where did you move from there? See, we got to the city directly. We can tell the exact date, you know, where you lived. You know, by looking your name up.
Yeah. The part that got me on back. Yeah, you got me there on Spain and Burry.
We'll have to look it all up and then come down and show you. And you can figure out when you lived in different places, who you were playing with. How long did you live on the harbor?
Let's see, I moved from the middle of the block to the corner.
On Burry, huh?
Burry in Spain.
And who were you playing with when you lived on Burry?
I played with most anybody.
Everybody, huh?
Yeah, mostly everything was. I was fitting.
